summary: Complaints centre on waterlogging on Loni roads, a stalled road work, garbage fires and an allegation of inflated culvert billing, while the main appreciation is the start of a new Hindon bridge and road renovation works.

round2.changes: Fetched and checked every cited URL. Positive 3 corrected: only the CC road start is confirmed, the drain was in its final stage. Positive 4 basis now says approval and tender only. Positive 5 reworded as a proposal and flagged. Negative 1 now cites the Amar Ujala 7 Sep 2026 original (two feet of water on Loni-Ghaziabad road) with Chetna Manch as the residents' claim. Negative 3 replaced: the Navbharat Indraprastha-scheme jam claim refers to Sahibabad, so it was swapped for the Amar Ujala 24 Jul 2026 stalled Delhi-Saharanpur road report. Negative 4 narrowed to the culvert billing allegation (the road-contract part was not in the source). Negative 5 replaced: the 2022 Maktoob hospital item was dropped, and the Amar Ujala 16 Jun 2026 incomplete drain-cleaning report was added. Removed sources: Maktoob (2022) and the Navbharat citation as a negative. Garbage item (2025) kept; no 2026 follow-up found.

positives.english: Work has started on a bridge over the Hindon linking Loni with Rajnagar Extension
positives.hindi: हिंडन पर लोनी को राजनगर एक्सटेंशन से जोड़ने वाले पुल का काम शुरू हुआ
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2026): MLA Nandkishor Gurjar launched work on a bridge of about 182 m over the Hindon at about Rs 42 crore, linking Loni with Raj Nagar Extension. Start only, not completed. Exact bridge location inside the AC is not stated.

positives.english: Renovation of the Loni-Bhopura road has started at about Rs 6 crore
positives.hindi: लोनी-भोपुरा मार्ग की मरम्मत का काम शुरू हो गया
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2026): Loni-Bhopura road renovation launched after a puja at Loni Tiraha, cost about Rs 6 crore. Article gives no completion timeline. Started, not completed.

positives.english: Cement concrete road work has started on Jindal Marg in DLF Colony, Loni
positives.hindi: डीएलएफ कॉलोनी में जिंदल मार्ग पर सीसी सड़क का काम शुरू हुआ
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (4 Jul 2025): CC road work launched on Jindal Marg, DLF Colony, Loni, as part of Rs 80 lakh development works; drain of over Rs 1 crore on both sides was in its final stage. Report is from 2025, current status unknown.

positives.english: Banthla-Dhikauli road in Loni to be widened, tender started, work promised before Diwali
positives.hindi: बंथला ढिकौली सड़क चौड़ी होगी, दिवाली से पहले काम शुरू होने की बात
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026): 8 km road, Rs 14.30 crore, widening from 3.75 m to 5.5 m approved; PWD executive engineer Ram Raja said the tender process has started and work will begin before Diwali. Approval and tender only; no work reported yet.

positives.english: New road from Teela Mod along Pipeline Road proposed under GDA plan to ease jams
positives.hindi: टीला मोड़ से पाइपलाइन रोड तक नई सड़क का प्रस्ताव है
positives.basis: Navbharat Live (23 Apr 2026): GDA Master Plan 2031 proposes a road from Teela Mod along Pipeline Road (phase 1 about 1,400 m, planned width 30 m, initial 15 m). Proposal only, not built. AC membership of Teela Mod unconfirmed: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026) places an Indraprastha scheme at Teela Mod in Sahibabad.

negatives.english: Rain floods the Loni-Ghaziabad road, more than two feet deep, and disrupts the Delhi-Saharanpur road
negatives.hindi: बारिश में लोनी-गाजियाबाद मार्ग पर दो फुट से ज़्यादा पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Sep 2026): more than two feet of water on the Loni-Ghaziabad road after rain; two-wheelers stalled and traffic on the Delhi-Saharanpur road disrupted. Chetna Manch (7 Sep 2026) reports residents claim about 7 km of the Delhi-Saharanpur road near Loni waterlogs (a claim, not verified).

negatives.english: Garbage heaps in Loni are set on fire every day, causing heavy pollution
negatives.hindi: लोनी में रोज़ कूड़े के ढेर में आग लगती है, धुएं से सांस लेना मुश्किल
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (26 Mar 2025): garbage heaps in Loni set alight daily; the report calls Loni a gas chamber and cites AQI 424 on the CPCB SAMEER app. Dated 2025; no 2026 follow-up found.

negatives.english: Half-built Delhi-Saharanpur road near Loni Depot has been stalled for about six weeks
negatives.hindi: लोनी डिपो से दिल्ली वाली सड़क का काम अधूरा, डेढ़ महीने से रुका
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (24 Jul 2026): work on the half of the Delhi-Saharanpur road from Loni Depot toward Delhi halted about 1.5 months for Jal Nigam sewer laying; PWD chief engineer Ram Raja confirmed the halt. Road has been under construction for roughly a year.

negatives.english: Allegation that culvert work in Loni was billed up to Rs 6 lakh against about Rs 1 lakh
negatives.hindi: पुलिया का बिल छह लाख तक बनाने का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Chetna Manch (7 Sep 2026): residents and unnamed sources allege a culvert approved at about Rs 1 lakh was billed up to Rs 6 lakh. Allegation only; not independently verified; no official clarification published yet.

negatives.english: Loni lanes stay waterlogged because drain cleaning work is incomplete
negatives.hindi: नाले की सफाई अधूरी है, गलियों में पानी जमा रहता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026): on Loni's broken roads, resident Murari Lal blames incomplete drain-cleaning work for water collecting in the lanes; no colony names given. Delhi-Saharanpur and Loni-Ghaziabad routes named for jams.

notes: AC 53 Loni confirmed on Wikipedia list (None reserved, Ghaziabad district). Negatives 1-3 and 5 name Loni roads or lanes from Amar Ujala reports datelined Loni. Negative 2 is from March 2025 and no 2026 follow-up was found. Positives are still thin: only started works and approvals were found, and no completed Loni project was found in 2026 searches. Positive 5 is a proposal only and is the weakest item; replace it with a completed project after a field check. Its AC membership is unconfirmed because Teela Mod also appears in Sahibabad. Hospital: the 2022 Maktoob item was dropped. Amar Ujala (20 May 2023) reports a 50-bed joint district hospital started treatment in Loni, and the Loni CHC still operates, so the no-hospital claim is outdated. The 2026 Amar Ujala CHC article (600-700 OPD patients daily, 3 Oct 2026) does not name Loni, so it was not used. Chetna Manch is a smaller outlet; its allegations are kept as allegations. Hindi statements are voice-style renderings of the sourced facts; field check the wording with local voters. Field check suggestion: Amar Ujala Ghaziabad desk on Loni drains, Loni-Ghaziabad road waterlogging, and any completed Loni roads or the Hindon bridge location.
